## Short Pitch

```text
Codex Task Queue turns product docs, development docs, and bug lists into executable workflow docs, then runs independent READY tasks with parallel Codex subagents in separate Git worktrees.
```

## Launch Post

```text
I built Codex Task Queue: a workflow layer for Codex that turns product docs, development docs, and bug lists into executable workflow docs.

It generates PRODUCT/TASK_QUEUE/PATCH_QUEUE/RUNBOOK docs, splits work into scoped READY tasks, then runs independent tasks through parallel Codex subagents in separate Git worktrees.

The goal: make AI coding work reviewable, resumable, auditable, and parallel.

Repo: https://github.com/Grey-G/codex-task-queue
```
